summary: Abandoned, unmaintained fire tower in the Mistinikon Lake Uplands Conservation Reserve, about 10 km west of Matachewan; last described in a 2004 report.

access.note: Crown land in a conservation reserve, reached by boat along Mistinikon Lake or by a hiking trail off its west shore. The 2004 report advises against climbing the tower.

visit.trail_note: About 1.5 km trail from the west shore of Mistinikon Lake, steep near the tower. The register gives a 3 km (1.9 mi) return trip with a 110 m (360 ft) elevation gain.

events.note: The Statement of Conservation Interest for the reserve describes the tower as abandoned and not maintained, and advises against climbing it

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register describes a canoe or boat route from the Mistinkon River. The 2004 report describes boat access along Mistinikon Lake and a trail off its west shore. These read as different approaches, not a contradiction.

sources.title: Statement of Conservation Interest, Mistinikon Lake Uplands Conservation Reserve (November 2004)

notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, design, height, staffing or fire record appears in any source read. The latest source is the November 2004 Statement of Conservation Interest, so the condition after 2004 is unknown; the brief's status 'unknown' is not corrected. The register leaves Elevation, Tower Type, Structure Height and Year Built as N/A. The register spells the river 'Mistinkon'; the 2004 report spells the lake 'Mistinikon'. The 2004 report says 'No roads or trails were observed' in the paragraph on human disturbance, which sits oddly beside its later trail description; not relied on. Possible alias: the Canada's Fire Lookouts Ontario list (canada-lookouts.weebly.com/ontario.html) has an entry 'POWELL' at 'Mistinikon Lake - Matachewan' with no other detail. Not used, since it may be a different site or a name for this one. The Ontario geoHub tower dataset named in the brief was not readable online.
